title: DASH: Dual-Branch Score Distillation for Guidance-Calibrated Compact Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.00798v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Parameter compression of class-conditional diffusion models exposes a structural limitation in output-level distillation: supervising only the guided output leaves the two score branches non-identifiable, so the classifier-free guidance gap is not determined in the student. The zero-loss set admits degenerate solutions in which both branches collapse toward identical predictions, and guidance loses its effect at inference despite low training loss. For each fixed input the objective is exactly flat in a branch-output direction at every residual value, so the ambiguity is a property of the output-level objective rather than a poor local minimum. This paper introduces DASH, which supervises the conditional and unconditional branches independently. An anchor term regularises the conditional prediction toward ground-truth noise, and the teacher's final learned per-timestep curriculum transfers into the student as a frozen prior. Ac

translated_title: DASH：面向引导校准紧凑扩散模型的双分支分数蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.00798v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：类条件扩散模型的参数压缩暴露了输出级蒸馏的一个结构性局限：仅监督引导后的输出会使两个分数分支不可辨识，因此无分类器引导差距在学生模型中无法被确定。零损失解集允许退化解的存在，即两个分支塌缩为完全相同的预测，导致尽管训练损失很低，引导在推理时却失去效果。对于每个固定输入，该目标函数在某一分支输出方向上于任意残差取值处均完全平坦，因此这种歧义是输出级目标本身的属性，而非糟糕的局部极小值。本文提出DASH，独立监督条件分支与无条件分支。一个锚定项将条件预测向真实噪声进行正则化，同时教师模型最终学到的逐时间步课程作为冻结先验迁移到学生模型中。
tldr: DASH通过独立监督条件与无条件两个分数分支（利用锚定项正则化条件预测，并将教师的逐时间步课程作为冻结先验迁移），解决了紧凑扩散模型输出级蒸馏中引导分支不可辨识导致的退化塌缩问题。
en_tdlr: DASH resolves the branch non-identifiability of output-level distillation in compact diffusion models by independently supervising the conditional and unconditional score branches, using an anchor term and the teacher's per-timestep curriculum transferred as a frozen prior.
